```{r, warning = FALSE, message = FALSE}
library(tidyverse)

library(splines)

```

# Data loading

```{r}
data <- read.csv("/Users/donghyunpark/Documents/Seoul National University/3rd year 1st semester/Data mining/1차 프로젝트/1차 프로젝트 데이터/Dataset.csv", fileEncoding = "euc-kr")
```

# Str

```{r}
data$화재발생시_항목 <- as.factor(data$화재발생시_항목)
data$화재발생월_항목 <- as.factor(data$화재발생월_항목)
data <- data %>%
  mutate_if(is.character, as.factor) %>%
  mutate(재산피해금액 = log(재산피해금액 + 1, base = 10)) %>% 
  select(-내국인생활인구수, -일최대인구수, -일최소인구수, -주간인구수.09.18., -야간인구수.19.08., -일최대이동인구수, -서울외유입인구수) %>%
  filter(시설장소대분류명 != "Other") %>%
  filter(최초착화물대분류명 != "Other")
  

data %>% str()
```


# Spline modeling

## 10 fold CV

```{r}
set.seed(1)
k_fold_result <- createFolds(data$재산피해금액, k=10, list=TRUE, returnTrain = FALSE)
```


## Col을 연속형과 이산형으로 분류

```{r}
continuous_cols <- data %>%
  select(-재산피해금액) %>%
  select_if(is.numeric) %>%
  names()

factor_cols <-data %>%
  select(-재산피해금액) %>%
  select_if(is.factor) %>%
  names()

continuous_terms <- paste0(continuous_cols, collapse = " + ")
factor_terms <- paste0(factor_cols, collapse = " + ")
interaction_continuous_terms <- combn(continuous_cols, 2, FUN=function(x) paste0(x[1], ":", x[2]))
interaction_continuous_terms <- paste0(interaction_continuous_terms, collapse=" + ")
interaction_cont_factor_terms <- paste0(paste(factor_cols, continuous_cols, sep = ":"), collapse = " + ")
interaction_factor_terms <- combn(factor_cols, 2, FUN=function(x) paste0(x[1], ":", x[2]))
interaction_factor_terms <- paste0(interaction_factor_terms, collapse = " + ")
```


## 2nd interaction added for continuous interactions MLR

```{r, warning = FALSE}
formula <- paste("재산피해금액 ~ ", factor_terms, "+", continuous_terms, "+", interaction_continuous_terms)

Fold_MSE <- c()
for (i in seq_along(k_fold_result)) {
  # Iteration number
  print(i)
  
  # i번째 fold를 테스트 데이터로 사용
  test <- data[k_fold_result[[i]], ]
  
  # 나머지 fold를 학습 데이터로 사용
  train <- data[-k_fold_result[[i]], ]
  
  model <- lm(formula = as.formula(formula), data = train)
  
  # i번째 fold에 대한 결과 저장
  Fold_MSE <- c(Fold_MSE, sum((test$재산피해금액-predict(model, test))^2)/(dim(test)[1]-dim(train)[1]+model$df.residual))
  
  print(Fold_MSE)
}
```

```{r}
mean(Fold_MSE)
```

```{r, warning = FALSE}

```

```{r}
mean(Fold_MSE)
```

## 2nd interaction added for all MLR

```{r, warning = FALSE}
formula <- paste("재산피해금액 ~ ", factor_terms, "+", continuous_terms, "+", interaction_continuous_terms, "+", interaction_cont_factor_terms, "+", interaction_factor_terms)

Fold_MSE <- c()
for (i in seq_along(k_fold_result)) {
  # Iteration number
  print(i)
  
  # i번째 fold를 테스트 데이터로 사용
  test <- data[k_fold_result[[i]], ]
  
  # 나머지 fold를 학습 데이터로 사용
  train <- data[-k_fold_result[[i]], ]
  
  model <- lm(formula = as.formula(formula), data = train)
  
  # i번째 fold에 대한 결과 저장
  Fold_MSE <- c(Fold_MSE, sum((test$재산피해금액-predict(model, test))^2)/(dim(test)[1]-dim(train)[1]+model$df.residual))
  
  print(Fold_MSE)
}
```

```{r}
mean(Fold_MSE)
```

## Spline added in continous & continuous interaction terms

### Natural Spline of degree of many degree of freedoms on continuous

```{r, warning=FALSE}
Fold_MSE_df <- vector(mode = "list", length = 7)


for (df in 1:4){
  print(df)
  df_command <- paste(", df = ", df, ")")
  spline_df_command <- paste(df_command, " + splines::ns(")
  
  spline_continuous_terms <- paste0(continuous_cols, collapse = spline_df_command)
spline_continuous_terms <- paste("splines::ns(", spline_continuous_terms, df_command)

  formula <- paste("재산피해금액 ~ ", factor_terms, "+", spline_continuous_terms)

  for (i in seq_along(k_fold_result)) {
  
    # i번째 fold를 테스트 데이터로 사용
    test <- data[k_fold_result[[i]], ]
  
    # 나머지 fold를 학습 데이터로 사용
    train <- data[-k_fold_result[[i]], ]
  
    model <- lm(formula = as.formula(formula), data = train)
  
    # i번째 fold에 대한 결과 저장
    Fold_MSE_df[[df]] <- c(Fold_MSE_df[[df]], sum((test$재산피해금액-predict(model, test))^2)/(dim(test)[1]-dim(train)[1]+model$df.residual))
  }
}
```

```{r}
mean(Fold_MSE_df[[1]])
mean(Fold_MSE_df[[2]])
mean(Fold_MSE_df[[3]])
mean(Fold_MSE_df[[4]])
```

### Natural Spline of degree of many degree of freedoms on continuous & continous term's interaction

```{r, warning=FALSE}
Fold_MSE_df <- vector(mode = "list", length = 4)


for (df in 1:4){
  print(df)
  df_command <- paste(", df = ", df, ")")
  spline_df_command <- paste(df_command, " + splines::ns(")
  
  spline_continuous_terms <- paste0(continuous_cols, collapse = spline_df_command)
spline_continuous_terms <- paste("splines::ns(", spline_continuous_terms, df_command)
  spline_interaction_continuous_terms <- combn(continuous_cols, 2, FUN=function(x) paste0(x[1], "*", x[2]))
  spline_interaction_continuous_terms <- paste0(spline_interaction_continuous_terms, collapse = spline_df_command)
  spline_interaction_continuous_terms <- paste("splines::ns(", spline_interaction_continuous_terms, df_command)
  
  formula <- paste("재산피해금액 ~ ", factor_terms, "+", spline_continuous_terms, "+", spline_interaction_continuous_terms)

  for (i in seq_along(k_fold_result)) {
  
    # i번째 fold를 테스트 데이터로 사용
    test <- data[k_fold_result[[i]], ]
  
    # 나머지 fold를 학습 데이터로 사용
    train <- data[-k_fold_result[[i]], ]
  
    model <- lm(formula = as.formula(formula), data = train)
  
    # i번째 fold에 대한 결과 저장
    Fold_MSE_df[[df]] <- c(Fold_MSE_df[[df]], sum((test$재산피해금액-predict(model, test))^2)/(dim(test)[1]-dim(train)[1]+model$df.residual))
  }
}
```

```{r}
mean(Fold_MSE_df[[1]])
mean(Fold_MSE_df[[2]])
mean(Fold_MSE_df[[3]])
mean(Fold_MSE_df[[4]])
```
